- Quick‑commerce long‑term growth guidance – raised from 5‑6 % to 6 % (period: long‑term).  
- Blinkit NAOV – expected to remain flat in the same range as last year (period: year‑on‑year).  
- Blinkit take‑rate improvement – not expected to materially lift contribution margin (period: current quarter).  
- Capex per store – increased, leading to higher efficiency and margin visibility (period: current quarter).
